notes.title: Gameplay and difficulty
notes.content:
Hi there!!
I am reading that some of you have trouble enjoying the game, because of the gameplay and the difficulty of the game, so I am writing to you.

Regarding the gameplay :

-You can change the keys (I have an « azerty » keyboard, and you have a « qwerty » keyboard)
   • Go to the settings menu, then to keys
   • Click on the key you wish to change, and then push the key on the keyboard that you wish to use.

- In order to move (this is how I play)
   • When the fox look at or is going to stare at the camera, I use the key to move forward, so the fox goes forward and I make him go to the left or right with the mouse (so I only use the forward key on the keyboard to direct him).
 • Feel free to change the camera sensitivity as well!


The difficulty : 

- Frankly the difficulty of the game was the hardest part to define, normally you should be able to finish the game, but I understand that some of you might be lost, if you want, you can already find on the internet videos with tips to finish the game.
 
There, so I hope this has been a little helpfull :)

Mata
